style_notes: Late delivery penalty: do not write the delivery date inside the penalty clause. Write it once, in the delivery clause, as a defined term of your own choice (a capitalised term in quotation marks and brackets), and in the penalty clause refer to the date only by that term.
extra_decoys: The Buyer shall inspect the Equipment within seven (7) days of delivery; Equipment not rejected in writing within that period is deemed accepted.
A restocking fee of 5% of the price of the returned goods applies to undamaged Equipment that the Buyer asks to return after acceptance.
